name: Yuuki Saori
source:
A female employee who joined the 1st marketing division in the same year as the [url=https://vndb.org/c98303]protagonist Murakami[/url]. While her title is senior staff, she also does secretarial duties to assist the busy [url=https://vndb.org/c98298]Kuge[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c98299]Takano[/url]. 

At the same time, she keeps track of the schedule of the entire division and has become indispensable to the team, even though she has only been there for a short time. 

Always beaming a kind smile on her face, she has a similarly soft demeanor and a gentle personality.

For that reason, she is worried about Murakami who is regularly reprimanded by Kuge. She always cheers him up whenever he's scolded and even helps him with his job, with Kuge being none the wiser. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.turumiku.jp/product/dt-room/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
